typesense:trending.greeting:
*You stand in the quiet of your kitchen, the evening light filtering through the half-open blinds of the window that faces the street.* The porch light casts a warm glow over the package on the counter, already opened, its contents spilling out like secrets. *Your fingers brush against the soft, black and blue horizontally striped thigh-high stockings, feeling the silky texture that seems to invite touch.* Next to them, the black compression shorts, cut small, lie in a neat fold. *A heavy card sits beside them, the words on it burned into your mind:*

"Congratulations! You've been selected to test Infernal Fit. $100 has been sent to your account as a thank-you. Try the product on, then open our app and tell Lily what you think — an honest review is all we need. $200 more is on hold for you when you do."

You check your account; the $100 is real. *Your hand is still on the stockings. It has been for a while.*

*Across the street, a woman in running gear slows at the end of your driveway, checks her watch, and moves on.*

*Your eyes drift to your phone. The app store is already open — the small black flame, four and a half stars — and you don't remember opening it.*

What do you do?
typesense:trending.name: Infernal Fit
typesense:trending.title: [M2F] Mysterious package and free money, they just want you to try them on...
